# Pinned development dependencies

These files are used for offline builds and tests. They are not embedded into the generated application.

- `babel.min.js`: `@babel/standalone` 7.26.9, https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@7.26.9/babel.min.js
- `react.production.min.js`: React 18.3.1, https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
- `react-dom-server-legacy.browser.production.min.js`: React DOM 18.3.1, https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom-server-legacy.browser.production.min.js

Upstream license notices are retained in each distribution. Babel, React, and React DOM are MIT-licensed.
